subject: CAIQ: key rotation evidence & retention mapping for Novamed
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novamed.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ request: key rotation proofs and retention window

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. We're running the CAIQ for our procurement review and we have a couple of tight asks around key management controls (specifically CCM_KM-01 / CCM_KM-02 equivalents in the CSA matrix). Can you provide: 

- A mapping that shows which Redwood CAIQ entries map to our key rotation and KMS logging controls (spreadsheet preferred).
- Representative evidence for rotation (rotation schedule, runbook) and a short sample of KMS audit/log output demonstrating a rotation event.
- Statement of retention windows for audit logs (S3 / KMS / runtime telemetry) and where those artifacts live.

We need the artifacts for our security review by Nov 30. If you have a suggested minimal bundle for CAIQ reviewers that includes owner contacts and DocuSign attestation links, please include that too.

Appreciate it —
Laura Chen
InfoSec Lead, Novamed
security@novamed.com

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novamed.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: key rotation proofs and retention window

Laura —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick plan: attaching a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet that highlights the key-management related control IDs and points to evidence artifacts. Summary here: 

- Mapping file: caiq_keyrotation_mapping_v1.xlsx (attached) — sheet 1 maps CSA control IDs to Redwood artifacts; sheet 2 lists named owners and time windows.
- Runbook: kms_rotation_runbook_v2.pdf (attached) — outlines scheduled rotation cadence (90 days default), emergency rotation steps, and required approvals.
- Sample logs: s3_access_log_sample.txt (attached) — a redacted excerpt showing a KMS rotation event and the associated S3 write of rotation metadata.

Internal owners: Jordan Blake is the control steward for KMS policies; Irene Choi can help with pulling raw CloudKMS audit ranges and redacting tenant identifiers for you.

Propose a short 30-min walkthrough early next week to confirm the package meets the CAIQ reviewer expectations. When are you available Mon/Tue?

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novamed.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: key rotation proofs and retention window

Laura —

A couple of clarifications from the steward side: 

1) Rotation event sampling: the audit corpus we've attached is a single redacted rotation event. If you need a date-range export (e.g., last 12 months) we can provide it under an evidentiary transfer that masks tenant IDs.

2) Retention: default retention for KMS audit logs is 2 years in our logging archive; S3 access logs are retained for 13 months by default unless the customer has requested extended retention. These are called out in the mapping under the "Retention" column.

3) DocuSign: if Novamed requires signed attestations for specific control assertions, Mateo can route the attestation template through DocuSign. I can pre-populate the control IDs for faster sign-off.

Mateo: per the runbook, the scheduled rotation cadence can be overridden for emergency rotations — I added an inline note in page 3.

-Jordan

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novamed.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: key rotation proofs and retention window

On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 at 11:03 AM mateo_alvarez@redwood.com wrote:
> Mateo —
> 
> Thanks for the clear list. Quick plan: attaching a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet that highlights the key-management related control IDs and points to evidence artifacts.

Laura — attaching a short checklist of the technical extraction I will perform for the walkthrough: 

- Export KMS Admin audit events for the sample rotation (UTC timestamps) and redact tenant IDs. Example gcloud audit filter used: 
  "timestamp>\"2026-08-01T00:00:00Z\" AND protoPayload.methodName:\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRingManager.UpdateCryptoKey\""

- Pull corresponding S3 object metadata that references the rotation marker (we store rotation metadata at s3://redwood-telemetry/rotation-markers/YYYY/). Sample command: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-telemetry/rotation-markers/2026/rotation-20260812.json -

- Produce a redaction report (artifact id: REDACT-2026-1123) indicating fields removed.

I will have extracts ready and hosted at the Drive link in the related_links field by Mon 23. If Novamed needs schema-level linkage (which CAIQ reviewers sometimes request), I can add a CSV that maps audit field -> CAIQ assertion.

—Irene
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novamed.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: key rotation proofs and retention window

Thanks — this looks great and exactly like what the reviewers asked for. Monday 23 worked but we saw the Drive link update; we're free Wednesday 25 at 10:00am PST for the 30-min walkthrough.

Can you also include the suggested attestation language (short paragraph) we can sign via DocuSign? If you can pre-fill the CAIQ control IDs that would speed procurement.

Best,
Laura
InfoSec Lead, Novamed
